Hi everyone! 

Some cool things are now available -- check out the latest website, along with a devlog post where I go over how I created this game within less than a year!

[url=https://eccentricstylist.github.io/#/games/a-winter-haunting]The website for [i]A Winter Haunting[/i][/url] is now publicly available! While this will have some minor updates as time goes on, you can find the following here:

[h2]New Devlog! (2/2)[/h2]

Are you an aspiring developer? Maybe you're also working towards a game while having a full-time job? Are you working on any projects solo? Or perhaps, you're interested in a bit of the "behind-the-scenes" for this game? 

Whatever your reasons are, check out this short devlog on how I created my first game, [i]A Winter Haunting[/i], within a year as a solo developer! 

While I am no expert, I thought that sharing my story can help some other gamedevs and my broader community in their own personal endeavors, along with giving a timelapse of some of my artwork in my voiceover! :) 

[previewyoutube=IzUGx1zSygA;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: New Patch Available | Demo Save Information | Walkthrough
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842832/e4650160fb206e29297e1ac361af57aa1481b07b.png[/img]
Hi everyone! 

Can you believe it has already been three days since the release of A Winter Haunting? I'm happy to see that people have been streaming, sharing, and participating in the discussions. Thank you so much for helping grow and contribute to the community! :) 

[h2]New Patch Available (1/3)[/h2]

While watching people's playthroughs and reading through some feedback, I've created a new patch with some small updates ([b]!! minor puzzle spoilers ensue -- these have been hidden just in case !![/b]). 

[h3]Here's a quick breakdown! [/h3]
❄ Typos fixed (6) -- mixture of misspelled words and names. 
❄ Mildewy Room: Sometimes Everlyn would render above Mel -- even when Mel is in front of her.
❄ Mildewy Room: Added missing hotspot for contraption interaction.
❄ Floral Room Puzzle: [spoiler]The matrix multiplication now requires you to only fill out two cells instead of three, to still maintain a bit of the mathematical element without having too much burden. P.s. It's totally fine if you don't get this! You can still proceed through the game even if it is incorrect![/spoiler]
❄ Sandy Room Puzzle: [spoiler]The board where you place the vector pages is now denoted as "magnetic board" for better signposting.[/spoiler]
❄ [spoiler]Interrogation[/spoiler] Room: [spoiler]The dialogue when clicking on the fox and summer room puzzle TVs was switched. This has now been corrected.[/spoiler]

[h2]Demo Save Information (2/3)[/h2]

While saves are enabled in the demos, these unfortunately [i][b]cannot be transferred to the main game[/b][/i]. 

When building my demo, I enabled a flag that would determine whether or not the build I'm deploying was a demo (along with removing all the scenes not pertinent to the demo from the demo build) -- as such, if you try to use a demo save file in the main game, you will get the "Thank you for playing this demo!" popup. 

If a lot of people would like to skip past this portion, I might consider adding some save files that people can download (or alternatively, pinning any community members who are willing to share in the discussions!) 

[h2]Walkthrough (3/3)[/h2]

I am currently in the midst of building my website, but in the meantime, I am sharing a [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sPyfk5r9OXUfzr5CcVydA9ilU54SK5gBHjQG1_byW4k/edit?tab=t.0]google drive link with a written walkthrough.[/url] 

I hope that this can help out! 
Hope you are all enjoying the holidays and A Winter Haunting! :D

notes.title: The Haunting Begins | Release + Launch Discount!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842832/e4650160fb206e29297e1ac361af57aa1481b07b.png[/img]

[b]After a year of development, A Winter Haunting has finally been released with a 15% launch discount! 
This discount is available for 2 weeks, so feel free to grab it at anytime during this period for a cheaper deal! :) [/b]

I wanted to take the time to thank everyone for their continued support through this journey -- whether it was on Discord, social media websites, or even direct emails! Without your support, I would not have been able to make it to this point! 

This was my first published game, so it was a long yet enjoyable ride. I learned a lot, and cannot wait to apply it to my next game. 

I will be looking into creating a website, along with publishing a walkthrough in the next two-threeish weeks :) 

Till then, I hope you all enjoy this game! Looking forward to seeing all of you in the community tabs!

notes.title: Updated Demo Build | NEW PLATFORMS + FEATURES!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

Firstly, I wanted to thank everyone for their patience through this last rung of testing, along with all my AMAZING beta-testers for helping me expand this to other platforms, such as the Steam Deck! :D 

I am excited to announce that the following features will be available for this game before my release this December 3rd: 

[list]
❄ Steam Deck Support (with Official Glyph Mappings + Automatic Virtual Keyboard Display!)
❄ Steam Cloud Saves
❄ Steam Achievements (30 total)
❄ 16:9 and 16:10 Aspect Ratio Support
❄ Laptop Builds for Mac and Windows
(?) Potentially a Linux build as well before release (if I can get some testing done beforehand as sanity!)
[/list]

notes.title: October 2024 Steam Next Fest + Beta Phase Progress!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Well it's that time of year...STEAM NEXT FEST!! WHOOHOOO!! 

I have opted in for this year, so definitely feel free to ask questions, post discussions, show screenshots, or even any fan artwork you have! :) 

On another note, I will be starting my second phase of beta testing next week! Major thanks to all the people who offered to dedicate some time to testing my game -- I know that it can be a lot of work!

notes.title: GUESS WHO FINISHED HER BASE BUILD?
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

Exciting news!! I finished my base build much earlier than I thought -- of course, in large part thanks to the support of my parents, the encouragement of my friends, and my amazing community (which includes you, yes you! :D) 

As of now, I'm integrating steam achievements and testing them out. I'm also just adding last-minute touches / aiming to fix some non-blocking bugs as well. 

In 1-2 weeks, I will be rolling out my first beta-testing phase, then a next one, and so on until late November, so that I can give you all a clean, (hopefully awesome!) build when it releases! :) 

If you're interested, please comment on this post with your email, send me an email at eccentricstylist@gmail.com, or [url=https://discord.gg/zj43FxKKvy]join my discord server[/url]! 

Looking forward to releasing my game and hearing back from the community! :D

notes.title: Where is Your Beta-Testing Feedback?
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

Thank you again for taking the time to try out my beta demo and provide your thoughts! 
Your time in playing is precious to me, and I really appreciate all the detailed feedback I am receiving! :) 

Wanted to give a quick heads up that as feedback responses are rolling in, I'm creating tickets for

A) Bugs -- pretty much any blocks or unintended behavior.

B) Improvements on UI that are frequently voiced and/or I believe could enhance the gameplay.

I usually try to check the responses I'm receiving everyday, work on these issues at night in the PT timezone, and release builds everyday (or every other day) addressing them! 

[b]For  transparency with my testers, if you would like to track these issues and where I am at, feel free to check out [u][url=https://petite-package-a34.notion.site/9a76ac5bfdd448f8ac743e51c2a26cbb?v=065f2a3d713d43409024d4ff33e8873f]this public link to my notion board[/url][/u]! :)[/b]

[b]Additionally, [u][url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Lj1kIdMzerwpyliVu4BUmoSHZ9WbV4iaTO9dXYu0tDM/edit?usp=sharing]at the top of the beta-testing document linked here[/url][/u], you can see the approximate time a new build is available (usually sometime in the night in the PT timezone). [/b]

[b]For anyone else who is interested in beta-testing, please feel free to check the link to the beta-testing document above as well! :) [/b]

Thank you again, and hope you are all having a great week! :D 

~ AB (Dev)

notes.title: Beta Testing in the Works!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! :)

Hope you've all been doing well over the past month! 

Things have been getting fairly hectic in the process of gamedev because I'm getting ready to beta-test a small demo of this game! :D 

They always say that last 10% is where the bulk of the work happens, and wow were they right! Sound effects, menus, and tests are much harder than I initially thought. 

The good news is that I am close to wrapping this up! In roughly a week, I will be ready to pass this on to beta-testers. [b]If you are interested in beta-testing, please feel free to comment on the post or email me at eccentricstylist@gmail.com ! :) [/b]

What are your thoughts? :) [/b]

Have a great weekend ahead!
